description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 UI-Layouts 提供可复制粘贴的 React + Next.js + TailwindCSS 组件与区块，首页列出 Hero、Feature、About、Team、Stats、Testimonial 等区块分类及数量，并展示 Dashboard、Accordion、Globe、Mouse Trail、DateTime Input 等组件预览。用户可浏览全部组件或区块，部分区块指向 Pro 付费站。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by UI-Layouts (https://www.ui-layouts.com/).
Technology stack: react, tailwind, css.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
